units.verdict: This unit's fix round worked. Of the 25 items, 23 are fixed in the new photographs, in the code, or both. FB-44 is partly done because one English string was missed, and nothing regressed. The notification rows now fit on a phone: the title is complete and the row ends in the time only (19.00). The notifications toolbar is full width, and 'Tandai semua dibaca' sits in the header menu. Unread rows lost the selected tint and aria-current. The activities pages use the area title 'Kegiatan siswa', and their empty states use a secondary button. Club detail now matches its sibling pages: its facts are in the header, enrolling opens a dialog from the primary action, members have a search and a filter pill, and removing a member goes through a row menu and a confirmation. Dates are formatted and schedules read 'Jumat, 15.00 – 16.30'. The WhatsApp and SSO settings pages now follow the session and SSO pattern: switch row, save bar, password inputs and hints. The workflow arrows are gone. The fix round caused three small new defects: the template editor shows the label 'Isi templat' twice; a dot separator dangles at a line end in the club facts on a phone; and on narrow pages the header action sits about 430px to the right of the 720px content.

units.verdict: The library fix round mostly worked. 18 of the 19 blocker, major and minor items are fixed, shown either in the new screenshots or in the code. The one blocker is gone: the phone dashboard cards now fit the screen and truncate their titles. The headmaster's dashboard no longer links to the desk or to member pages. Each empty list shows a single primary button, the stocktake list has no primary button per row, and the phone report page has a Select. Member loan cards keep the whole title and due date, and the overdue hero is danger-toned. One item, FA-22, is not fixed. Its empty state is now compact, but the overdue queue sits exactly where it did, because the side panel sets the height of the first grid row. That leaves a 215px empty gap in the left column of the idle desk. Four new problems are worth fixing before release. One is minor: five more library lists still show two identical primary buttons when they are empty. Three are polish: the member header title sits at the top of its 64px avatar, the long follow-up link pushes the phone dashboard's overdue card title onto two lines, and the desk shortcut icon circles touch the row dividers.

units.verdict: Most of this unit landed well. The settings hub on a phone is now a real grouped settings list. The theme, security, session, branding and report-header pages are clean, and the school-setup, year-wizard and supervision report screens no longer show dead or empty filler. Three things still miss the bar. First, the setup checklist on a phone got worse: moving the counts to the row's trailing side made the title column too narrow, so 'Penempatan siswa ke kelas' is cut off after 'ke' with no ellipsis, the 'Opsional' badges drop onto their own line, and the descriptions are cut short. Second, the supervision cycle page still has the orphan density and column icon row over its two-row table. The fixer reported adding viewOptions={false}, but that change is not in the merged code. Third, on /school/learning the Mapel tab still puts 'Tambah mapel' in the table toolbar (a full-width bar above the search on a phone). The academic plumbing for a header primary action exists, but the school-owned SubjectsView is still a body section. The fix round also introduced two smaller problems: the leave-issuer text tells the reader to open notifications while the primary button opens the queue, and the shared stat strip now gives its cells unequal widths.

units.unit: Regression sweep: unrequested changes (34 pairs), two unreviewed detail screens, three worst phone screens
units.verdict: Mostly no. Of the 34 screens that changed without a fix item naming them, 32 got better or stayed neutral. The shared fixes underneath did their job: stat strips no longer cut off at the phone edge, the tab bar is opaque, scanners fit above the fold, area headers stay put between tabs, orphan toolbar controls and duplicate empty-state primaries are gone, and the URL-state tabs now open the right tab. Two small regressions came from fixes landing on screens they were not aimed at. (1) On the phone forbidden page, adding a house icon to the primary button made the two actions too wide for one row, so they wrap into two stacked buttons of unequal width (775ff47b, state-page.tsx:95). (2) On a phone, the library kiosk is now a third longer. A hint card meant to fill the desktop side column repeats step 1 under the camera (8706df78). The fix round also left defects on the two screens nobody had reviewed. On the leave request page, 3bd8b74e moved the 'Surat izin sudah terbit' alert to the top, so its text 'Surat bisa diunduh di atas' now points up at a button that sits below it. Its new sticky approve/reject block uses the full tab offset, so it floats 32px above the tab bar (the gap 2efc82a3 closed for every other bar) and is about 220pt tall. The document template editor has an older blocker the fix round did not cause. Its placeholder parser, insert buttons and preview all use {{name}}, but the API renders Go html/template, which needs {{.name}}. So the preview shows raw tokens, the page says no automatic data is used, saving sends variables: [], and every inserted chip breaks letter issuing. On the three worst phone screens, the home's three figures leave half a row empty, the library's 7-figure collection strip still ends mid-word at the screen edge, and the empty notifications inbox still shows a search, a filter and a '...' menu whose only item is disabled.

newFindings.title: Template editor does not understand the template syntax the API renders
newFindings.description: The preview shows raw {{.letter_number}} and {{.student_name}}, and 'Data otomatis yang dipakai' says 'Templat ini belum memakai data otomatis' for a template that uses five fields. Saving sends variables: []. Every 'Sisipkan data otomatis' chip inserts {{letter_number}} (no dot), which Go html/template rejects at issue time ('function not defined'). After one edit, 'Terbitkan surat' fails for every leave letter. The chip list also lacks NIS, Alamat, Penerbit and Wali kelas, which the API provides.
newFindings.cause: apps/web/features/documents/api.ts:112: PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN /\{\{\s*([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}/g has no leading dot. template-editor.tsx:179 inserts `{{${placeholder}}}`. api.ts:151 replaces only `{{name}}`. The API parses bodies with html/template (apps/api/internal/platform/documents/renderer.go:75), and the seed uses {{.name}} (apps/api/internal/modules/permits/service/leaverequest.go:484-494). The API does not validate on save. KNOWN_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDERS (api.ts:131) is out of sync with leaveLetterTemplateVariables (leaverequest.go:502-505).
newFindings.fix: Match the API syntax. Change the pattern to /\{\{\s*\.([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\}/g. Insert `{{.${placeholder}}}` and use the same token in the chip title. In renderPreviewHtml, replace each /\{\{\s*\.name\s*\}\}/g with a sample. Add nis, address, issuer_name and homeroom_name to KNOWN_TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDERS.leave_letter, with labels in documents.id.json and en.json. Server-side, parse the body with html/template on create and update, and reject a template that does not parse.

newFindings.title: Four tall tiles fill the library home's first screen
newFindings.description: Four 130pt tiles (mostly zeros) take about 590pt of the 844pt screen, pushing the chart and lists down. The school home uses the compact strip on phones for the same kind of figures.

newFindings.title: Empty inbox still shows a menu, a segmented filter, a search and a kind select

Render the search and kind filter only when items.length > 0 or isFiltering, and the segmented control only when there are notifications or unread ones. Replace the Select with the shared single-choice filter pill (data-table-filters with ResponsivePopover), as the other lists use.
